result.title: DAQ: Decision-Aligned Post-Training Quantization for Spiking Transformers
result.summary: Spiking transformers combine attention-based representation learning with sparse spike communication, yet their weights and membrane variables still incur substantial storage and computation overhead. Post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical way to reduce these overheads, but preserving neuronal firing under weight and membrane quantization remains challenging. In this paper, we propose Decision-Aligned Post-Training Quantization (DAQ), a method that calibrates the quantizers to align neuronal firing decisions with those of a floating-point reference. We analyze how errors from these quantizers affect firing at decision boundaries and how they propagate over time steps in recurrent neurons. Based on this analysis, we formulate an objective that encourages quantized membrane variables to remain within the reference firing regions along the quantized model's own state trajectory. Experiments across multiple spiking transformer architectures on image classification, semantic segmentation, and event-based tracking demonstrate the effectiveness of DAQ with 4-bit weights and membrane variables. On FE108, DAQ achieves 58.8\% AUC and 90.9\% PR with SDTrack, while reducing energy by 66.2\%.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出决策对齐的训练后量化方法（DAQ），通过校准量化器使脉冲 Transformer 的脉冲发放决策与浮点参考一致，以支持权重与膜电位的 4-bit 量化。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作聚焦脉冲网络的量化压缩与能效，虽涉及时序膜状态和发放决策对齐，但不研究视觉推理中的 latent 状态生成、证据使用或停止决策，也无具体可迁移的 LVR 方法线索，故排除。
